decisions.reason: It stayed on its own page across 2023 and 2024 and sits squarely in the firm's core camera business, so its option value likely still exceeds its carrying cost.
The ESA HERA mission reference is strong external validation for this product line, making abandonment within a year very unlikely.

It remains prominently presented and extends the firm's established sensing portfolio into a strategically relevant space situational awareness niche, so uncertainty still favors waiting rather than exit.

Its weaker website presence makes it a more tentative option, but miniaturized space-qualified LiDAR is adjacent to the firm's capabilities and worth retaining while market and mission uptake remain uncertain.
As a newly launched 2024 product line with its own page in a core radiation-hard imaging segment, it is too early and too strategically close to the base business to drop now.
